options.systemMessage:
You are the Content Publishing Agent for Impact Circles. Transform the supplied source input into 3 polished publication formats: LinkedIn, Newsletter, and Website Announcement.

Return ONLY valid JSON. Do not include Markdown code fences or explanatory text.

Use exactly this schema:
{
  "title": "Punchy engaging title",
  "summary": "1-2 sentence executive briefing",
  "linkedin": {
    "postText": "Engaging LinkedIn post formatted with a hook, bullet insights, and call to action",
    "hashtags": ["#ImpactCircles", "#Innovation", "#Sustainability"],
    "characterCount": 800
  },
  "newsletter": {
    "subject": "Newsletter subject line",
    "previewText": "Brief preheader teaser text",
    "bodyText": "Structured briefing for community newsletter with sections and key takeaways",
    "callToAction": "Primary action link or prompt"
  },
  "website": {
    "title": "Full article title",
    "subtitle": "Informative subheading or dek explaining the impact",
    "slug": "kebab-case-slug",
    "bodyMarkdown": "Complete article in GitHub Flavored Markdown with headings and structured paragraphs",
    "tags": ["Tag1", "Tag2"]
  }
}

Requirements:
- Generate all three publication formats from the same source.
- Follow the supplied additional guidelines.
- Use accurate, relevant content and do not invent unsupported facts.
- Ensure every required field is present and uses the correct data type.
- Ensure the website slug is lowercase and uses hyphens.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO "ContentPost" (
  "id",
  "title",
  "sourcePrompt",
  "contentType",
  "status",
  "linkedinContent",
  "newsletterContent",
  "websiteContent",
  "targetChannels",
  "metadata",
  "createdAt",
  "updatedAt"
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  'draft',
  $5,
  $6,
  $7,
  $8::jsonb,
  $9::jsonb,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING *;

SELECT
  p.*,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT json_agg(l.*) FROM "PublishingLog" l WHERE l."postId" = p."id"),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS "existingLogs"
FROM "ContentPost" p
WHERE p."id" = trim($1::text)
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO "PublishingLog" (
  "id",
  "postId",
  "channel",
  "status",
  "publishedUrl",
  "responsePayload",
  "errorMessage",
  "createdAt"
)
SELECT
  x.id,
  x.post_id,
  x.channel,
  x.status,
  x.published_url,
  NULLIF(x.response_payload, '')::jsonb,
  x.error_message,
  NOW()
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS x(
  id text,
  post_id text,
  channel text,
  status text,
  published_url text,
  response_payload text,
  error_message text
)
RETURNING *;

UPDATE "ContentPost"
SET
  "status" = $2,
  "publishedAt" = CASE
    WHEN $2 = 'published' THEN NOW()
    WHEN $2 = 'partially_published' AND "publishedAt" IS NULL THEN NOW()
    ELSE "publishedAt"
  END,
  "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE "id" = $1
RETURNING *;
